title: Quality Analyst
description:
Hiring: QA Engineer (Manual & Automation Testing)

**Company:** Viha Digital Commerce Pvt. Ltd.  
**Job Location:** Ashram Road, Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Experience:** 6 Months – 1 Year  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Working Days:** Monday to Friday  
**Working Hours:** 10:30 AM – 7:45 PM

**About Viha Digital Commerce**

Viha Digital Commerce Pvt. Ltd. is a digital commerce and technology solutions company specializing in eCommerce development, web development, and digital transformation. We work with technologies such as Magento, Shopify, PrestaShop, WordPress, WooCommerce, and other modern web technologies to deliver high-quality digital solutions to clients worldwide.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented **QA Engineer with knowledge of Manual and Automation Testing** to join our team. The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of software testing methodologies, experience in writing and executing test cases, and familiarity with automation testing tools and frameworks.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform manual and automated testing of websites, web applications, and eCommerce platforms.
* Analyze project requirements and prepare test scenarios, test cases, and test data.
* Execute functional, regression, smoke, integration, and usability testing.
* Develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts for web applications.
* Work with automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright.
* Identify, document, track, and report software defects using bug-tracking tools.
* Retest resolved bugs and perform regression testing.
* Verify website functionality across different browsers, devices, and screen sizes.
* Test eCommerce features, including product listings, search, cart, checkout, and payment workflows.
* Collaborate with developers and project managers to resolve quality issues.
* Maintain test documentation and communicate testing progress and results.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 6 months to 1 year of experience in QA or Software Testing.
* Basic knowledge of Manual Testing and Automation Testing.
* Understanding of SDLC, STLC, and software testing methodologies.
* Experience in writing and executing test cases and test scenarios.
* Basic hands-on knowledge of any automation tool, such as Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright.
* Familiarity with programming or scripting languages such as Java, Python, or JavaScript is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of API testing using Postman is a plus.
* Familiarity with bug-tracking tools such as Jira or similar platforms.
* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and browser developer tools is desirable.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities.
* Good communication skills and a willingness to learn new technologies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to eCommerce platforms such as Magento or Shopify.
* Basic knowledge of Git and version control.
* Familiarity with cross-browser and responsive testing.
* Understanding of automation framework concepts.

**Apply Now**

Interested candidates can share their updated resumes at:

**Company:** Viha Digital Commerce Pvt. Ltd.  
**Email:** hr@vihadigitalcommerce.com / julie.jose@vdcstore.com  
**Contact:** +91 88666 88722  
**Office Address:** 802–806, Sakar-9, Near Old RBI Bank, Ashram Road, Ahmedabad, Gujarat – 380008.

**Be part of our team and help us deliver reliable, high-quality digital experiences!**

Pay: ₹12,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

* Ahmedabad, Gujarat: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

title: Senior Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
**About Dash Technologies**
===========================

Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, USA, Dash Technologies Inc. is a healthcare-focused technology company with a global delivery center in Ahmedabad, India. For more than 15 years, Dash has partnered with healthcare and MedTech organizations to design and engineer digital health solutions spanning Medical IoT, device and system integration, connected applications, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data analytics. Dash combines strong engineering capabilities with practical execution to advance healthcare’s digital transformation and improve care delivery.

**The Opportunity**
===================

Dash Technologies is seeking an experienced **Manual Software Tester / QA Engineer** to support software testing and quality assurance for a Medical Device Software product being built from scratch.

You will be responsible for developing and executing test cases, identifying and tracking defects, supporting verification and validation activities, and ensuring high-quality software releases.

This is a **hands-on individual contributor role** focused primarily on manual testing. Experience with test automation is desirable but **optional**.

**What You’ll Do**
==================

**Manual Software Testing**
---------------------------

* Develop, review, and maintain test cases, test scenarios, test scripts, and test data.
* Execute functional, regression, integration, system, exploratory, and user acceptance testing.
* Analyze requirements and create comprehensive test scenarios covering positive, negative, boundary, and edge cases.
* Identify, document, and track software defects through resolution using bug-tracking tools.
* Perform retesting and regression testing after defect fixes and software changes.
* Review test results and provide clear testing status and release-readiness updates.
* Validate software functionality across different environments, configurations, and supported platforms.
* Participate in release testing and ensure identified issues are appropriately addressed before release.

**Requirements and Test Coverage**
----------------------------------

* Review business, functional, and technical requirements to ensure they are testable and clearly understood.
* Identify gaps, ambiguities, dependencies, and potential risks in requirements.
* Define acceptance criteria and contribute to backlog refinement.
* Maintain traceability between requirements, test cases, defects, and test results where required.
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to clarify expected behavior and acceptance criteria.

**Quality Assurance**
---------------------

* Contribute to test planning and overall QA strategy for the product.
* Maintain organized and accurate testing documentation and records.
* Ensure testing activities are performed consistently across development cycles.
* Participate in defect triage, root cause discussions, and quality reviews.
* Communicate testing progress, risks, blockers, and quality concerns to relevant stakeholders.
* Support continuous improvement of testing processes and practices.

**Agile Testing**
-----------------

* Work closely with Agile development teams throughout the sprint lifecycle.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Perform testing within development sprints rather than only at the end of the development cycle.
* Collaborate with developers to reproduce, investigate, and resolve defects.
* Ensure acceptance criteria are adequately covered before stories are considered complete.
* Support appropriate quality gates before software releases.

**Test Automation — Optional**
------------------------------

* Experience with test automation is an advantage but is **not mandatory**.
* Contribute to identifying suitable test cases for automation.
* Work with automation engineers or developers to improve automated test coverage.
* Basic experience with automation tools or frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar is desirable.
* Familiarity with CI/CD-based automated testing is a plus.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**
----------------------------------

* Partner with product managers and business analysts to understand requirements and expected outcomes.
* Work closely with software developers to investigate and resolve defects.
* Collaborate with other QA team members to improve test coverage and testing practices.
* Communicate testing status, defects, risks, and blockers clearly to project stakeholders.
* Participate in product demonstrations and reviews to understand new functionality.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* **At least 3–5 years of experience in software testing or quality assurance.**
* Strong hands-on experience in **manual software testing**.
* Experience developing and executing test cases, test scenarios, test scripts, and test plans.
* Experience performing functional, regression, integration, system, and exploratory testing.
* Strong understanding of software testing concepts and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Experience identifying, documenting, and tracking defects using tools such as Jira or similar platforms.
* Experience working with Agile methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.
* Experience with test management tools such as Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, QATouch, or similar platforms.

**Bonus Points**
================

* Experience testing **Medical Device Software, Healthcare Software, or MedTech products**.
* Experience working on products developed from scratch.
* Experience testing web applications, mobile applications, APIs, or integrated systems.
* Basic knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman or similar.
* Basic SQL/database testing experience.
* Experience with test automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, or similar.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution.
* Experience with performance, usability, compatibility, or security testing.
* Experience working in a startup or new product development environment.
* Experience with Medical IoT or connected healthcare applications.

**How You Work**
================

**Skills and Competencies**
---------------------------

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to think from an end-user perspective and identify unexpected scenarios.
* Strong defect investigation and root cause analysis skills.
* Good understanding of risk-based testing and test prioritization.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple testing activities.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively with developers, product managers, business analysts, and other stakeholders.
* Strong ownership of assigned testing activities.
* Willingness to learn new technologies, tools, and testing techniques.

**Values We Seek**
==================

* **Quality Mindset:** Commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality software.
* **Customer Focus:** Ability to understand software from the user's perspective.
* **Attention to Detail:** Thoroughness in identifying defects and validating functionality.
* **Collaboration:** Effective communication and teamwork across technical and non-technical teams.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Interest in improving testing processes, coverage, and efficiency.

**Why Join Dash**
=================

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* A hands-on QA role supporting a Medical Device Software product from the ground up.
* The opportunity to contribute to testing strategy and quality practices for a new product line.
* Exposure to Medical IoT, artificial intelligence, and digital health initiatives.
* A collaborative team at our Ahmedabad delivery center.
* Competitive compensation, performance-based bonuses, and comprehensive benefits.
* Professional development support for training and industry certifications.
* Flexible work arrangements and a culture that values quality, innovation, and continuous improvement.

title: QA Engineer
description:
### **Description**

As a Automation Engineer, you will be involved throughout the development lifecycle of Infor Birst development team with responsibility in the quality assurance of software development and deployment with emphasis on development and implementation of test automation. You'll be involved in the creation of business requirements inputting the test scripts and test scenarios to ensure developers understand the business requirements so that they can be effectively tested.  
  
You will be working closely with developers as they develop code to ensure requirements are being met and to the correct quality, and you will conduct automated (and manual tests where necessary) to ensure the software created is fit for purpose. During testing you will be thinking "outside of the box" to understand the various scenarios and configurations that customers use to ensure customer quality is maintained and through doing so drive regression testing across the products. You will be responsible for defining and driving innovative automated testing strategies and toolsets into our overall development processes that support and enhance the current Quality Assurance processes within Birst.  
  
We are seeking exceptional QA automation engineers to join our team in Ahmedabad, India to design and execute test suites for our Business Intelligence and Analytics products. In addition to regular quality assurance activities, automating tests using common automation frameworks such as TestNG and Selenium, is a requirement. So, if the thought of automation is exciting and if you can do most of the following then you’re going to fit right in with our exciting team here.

### **A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**

  

* Work as part of cross functional, passionate agile development teams to ensure quality is driven into the heart of the development process from requirements definition through to delivery of highly concurrent system
* Evangelize new testing methodologies, best practices, and tools with goals to continuously improve test coverage through automation
* Proactively bringing issues and problems to the attention of the team, generating, proposing, and implementing innovative solutions to solve them
* Be meticulous about documentation and maintaining test cases and test results.
* Designing, developing, and supporting frameworks for test infrastructure and providing automation expertise
* Research, recommend and implement tools as needed with the goal of increasing automation
* Ensure that all tests are executed and give regular feedback to the team lead on the status of quality
* Work closely with the Product Management and Development Teams
* Be a creative thinker who can quickly identify and test for functional ‘edge cases’ outside of expected functionality workflow
* Test backend API's (REST and SOAP) and front-end UI applications
* Mentor team members on automation
* Willingness to work across time zones to interact with different stakeholders located across US west coast, Europe, and India

  

### **Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of experience as hands on Software QA/automation Engineer
* Strong programming/scripting ability in any language, preferably Java
* Thorough understanding of SDLC, specifically automated QA processes in agile development environments
* Experience in writing, executing, and monitoring automated test suites using a variety of technologies including, but not limited to, Selenium, Groovy, Junit, TestNG, SoapUI, RESTful Client
* Proficient with bug tracking and test management toolsets to support development processes
* Strong working knowledge of testing fundamentals such as TDD & BDD
* Expertise testing RESTful, SOAP web services in SOA system
* Working knowledge of Database concepts
* + Demonstrated knowledge of CI/CD tools to integrate the Automation scripts
* + Strong experience in testing ETL, BI and SaaS solutions
* + A high degree of self-motivation and flexibility with the ability to organize and prioritize multiple tasks
* + The ability to interact creatively and achieve results in a fast-moving, dynamic small company environment
* + Excellent communication and teamwork skills

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Domain knowledge in Business Intelligence or Data Analytics
* Prior experience working with systems such as ActiveMQ, MongoDB, Elastic-Search and nginx
* Prior experience with security protocols such as OAuth and SAML and related frameworks
* Working knowledge of virtualization and Infrastructure as Service solutions such as Amazon Web Services
* Building test infrastructures using containerization technologies such as Docker and working within continuous delivery / continuous release pipeline processes
* ISTQB, CSQA or CSTE certified
